Smart Buildings Competition 2026 (Kaggle)

Kaggle code competition on smart-building control with a NeurIPS 2026 workshop paper track. Run as notebooks with up to 9 hours and no internet.

PRIZE POOL
$40,000
Reward details
US$40,000: US$25,000 across eight leaderboard places (US$5,750 down to US$2,500) and US$15,000 paper track.
Final submissions and papers (15 Jan 2027 23:59 UTC)
16 Jan 2027, 05:29 IST
Format & location
Online · Worldwide
Who can apply
Kaggle users aged 18+ worldwide except Crimea, DNR, LNR, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and sanctioned persons. Teams of up to 5.
Team size
1–5 participants

Entry notes

  • Poster paper deadline 13 Nov 2026; last day to join teams 3 Jan 2027.
  • Reinforcement learning
  • Kaggle
  • Energy
